mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 3-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation requiring restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that supports higher consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 3-month moving average, it signals a manufacturing contraction that precedes economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 3-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals monetary tightening suppressing consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and RSAFS falls, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.5%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its trend indicates a manufacturing slowdown that precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances during slowing GDP growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
